slice 2 (follow-up 2): vector (incl. nib strokes/gradients from SMB-COMPOSITE-VECTOR-IN-GROUP), text (prepared planes) and live boolean group layers take the same static path (owned coverage masks and painted tiles copied into the scene, caller tiles/image paints/mask tiles via ScenePixels::tile/mask); adjustment layers become SceneContent::Adjustment (records converted by the static converter): pigment adjustment envelope on a transparent placeholder over the composition rect, layer opacity/mode, applying to everything below; refusals adjustment_record_missing (and the converter's codes), composition_adjustment_transform, composition_adjustment_matte, composition_layer_not_in_graph, composition_space

slice 3 (follow-up 3): collapse_transformations expands the nested composition's layers into the outer one (nested matrix then the layer matrix, matte chains too; opacity times the layer opacity; no nested surface, no clip); composition_collapse_blend_mode, composition_collapse_matte refused

slice 4: CompositionTemporalSource::lower_document_frame(FrameRequest, tick, SceneContext) for the document-graph path: precompositions rendered through the scene path into surfaces, the precomposition layer given a synthetic raster tile (composite-precomp) and a Folio source operation in the frame document (composite resolver/tile-info wrappers), placed by lower_frame with the scene matrix; track mattes rendered to coverage_u16le planes and set as the mask of the matted layer's plan entry; matte sources hidden; DocumentFrame::sources; refusals composition_collapse_on_document_graph, composition_matte_with_mask, composition_matte_target_not_found, composition_precomp_graph_operation
